prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean UV tanning beds or spray (airbrush/mist) tans? Preferences (price, proximity, open late) or any other requirements will help me pick the best option.

If you want a quick way to find the “best” place right now, tell me if you want me to look up current reviews and hours online. I can do that and return a short list of top-rated salons in Tyler with contact info.

If you’d rather decide yourself, here’s a short checklist for choosing the best tanning salon and some safety tips:

Checklist for choosing a tanning salon
- Type of tanning: UV booths/beds vs. spray/mist — pick based on results you want and risk tolerance.
- Reviews & ratings: check Google, Yelp, and Facebook for recent customer feedback and photos.
- Cleanliness: beds and rooms should be spotless; ask about cleaning procedures between clients.
- Equipment & options: newer beds with adjustable settings, different spray tan formulas or experienced technicians.
- Staff expertise: friendly, knowledgeable staff who do patch tests for spray tans and explain exposure times.
- Packages & pricing: compare single sessions vs. membership plans and look for introductory deals.
- Licensing & safety: confirm technicians are trained; ask about ventilation for spray booths and eye protection.
- Location & hours: convenient hours if you’re tanning regularly.

Safety notes
- UV tanning increases skin cancer risk and speeds skin aging — consider spray tans or gradual self-tanners as safer alternatives.
- If you use beds, follow recommended exposure times for your skin type and never exceed advised sessions.
- Use protective eyewear and remove makeup/perfume before spray sessions; do a patch test if you have sensitive skin.

Would you like me to look up the current top-rated tanning salons in Tyler, TX and list a few with ratings, addresses and phone numbers? If so, tell me whether you prefer UV or spray tanning.
